description: This Python source file implements the RunwayML Text-to-Speech (TTS) integration. It defines configurations, request/response transformations, environment validation, and polling mechanisms for handling RunwayML's TTS API, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations. The class manages mapping of OpenAI-style parameters to RunwayML-specific formats, environment setup, and task status polling until completion.

classes.name: RunwayMLTextToSpeechConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interfacing with RunwayML's TTS API, including parameter mappings, environment validation, URL management, and polling operations for asynchronous task completion.
